title: Fuzzy Logic Mathematical Bundle
description: Add mathematical/fuzzy crate (mathematical_fuzzy) with full advanced fuzzy logic: type-1/IT2/IFS sets, membership functions, inference engines (Mamdani/Sugeno/Tsukamoto/Larsen), defuzzification, ANFIS, rule learning, hierarchical MIMO, FCM, fuzzy AHP/TOPSIS/VIKOR, evolving systems, explainability. Zero external numerics deps.
summary:
Added the full `mathematical/fuzzy` bundle (`mathematical_fuzzy` crate, `@semio-tech/math-fuzzy` nx package) implementing advanced fuzzy logic end-to-end in a single `lib.rs`:

**Foundation:** membership functions (triangular, trapezoidal, Gaussian, bell, sigmoid, singleton, piecewise-linear), type-1/IT2/IFS sets, t-norms/t-conorms, hedges, fuzzy arithmetic with α-cuts, fuzzy relations (max-min/max-product composition), possibility/necessity measures.

**Inference:** linguistic variables, weighted/confident rules, Mamdani/Sugeno/Tsukamoto/Larsen/hybrid engines, MIMO and hierarchical systems, full defuzzification suite, explainability traces.

**Learning:** adaptive MF fitting, ANFIS hybrid learning, Wang–Mendel rule induction, subtractive clustering, rule pruning/weighting, GA and PSO optimizers, evolving fuzzy systems.

**Applications:** fuzzy c-means + Gustafson–Kessel, fuzzy AHP/TOPSIS/VIKOR, temporal/spatial evaluators, hybrid uncertainty bridges, `FanController` demo pipeline.

Wired into workspace `Cargo.toml`, launch.json (`🧪test🧮mathematical-fuzzy`), with 17 passing tests (fundamental + long). Zero external numerics deps; depends only on `mathematical_algebra`, `mathematical_random`, `serde`, `thiserror`.
